00011   !      Date       Programmer          Description of change

00048   RECURSIVE SUBROUTINE add_node (ptr, new_node)
00049     !
00050     !  Purpose:
00051     !    To add a new node to the binary tree structure.
00052     !
00053     TYPE (node), POINTER :: ptr  ! Pointer to current pos. in tree
00054     TYPE (node), POINTER :: new_node ! Pointer to new node
00055 
00056     IF ( .NOT. ASSOCIATED(ptr) ) THEN
00057       ! There is no tree yet.  Add the node right here.
00058       ptr => new_node
00059     ELSE IF ( new_node < ptr ) THEN
00060 !      IF ( (new_node%coord2) .EQ. 2 .AND. (new_node%coord3 .EQ. 2) ) PRINT *, new_node%wait_time,"<",ptr%wait_time
00061       IF ( ASSOCIATED(ptr%before) ) THEN
00062         CALL add_node ( ptr%before, new_node )
00063       ELSE
00064         ptr%before => new_node
00065         new_node%parent => ptr
00066         new_node%leftRight = 0
00067       END IF
00068     ELSE
00069 !      IF ( (new_node%coord2) .EQ. 2 .AND. (new_node%coord3 .EQ. 2) ) PRINT *, new_node%wait_time,">",ptr%wait_time
00070       IF ( ASSOCIATED(ptr%after) ) THEN
00071         CALL add_node ( ptr%after, new_node )
00072       ELSE
00073         ptr%after => new_node
00074         new_node%parent => ptr
00075         new_node%leftRight = 1
00076       END IF
00077     END IF
00078   END SUBROUTINE add_node

00080   RECURSIVE SUBROUTINE write_node (ptr)
00081     !
00082     !  Purpose:
00083     !    To write out the contents of the binary tree
00084     !    structure in order.
00085     !
00086     TYPE (node), POINTER :: ptr  ! Pointer to current pos. in tree
00087 
00088     ! Write contents of previous node.
00089     IF ( ASSOCIATED(ptr%before) ) THEN
00090       CALL write_node ( ptr%before )
00091     END IF
00092 
00093     ! Write contents of current node.
00094     !WRITE (*,*) ptr%wait_time, ptr%coord1, ptr%coord2, ptr%coord3
00095 
00096     ! Write contents of next node.
00097     IF ( ASSOCIATED(ptr%after) ) THEN
00098       CALL write_node ( ptr%after )
00099     END IF
00100   END SUBROUTINE write_node

00102   RECURSIVE SUBROUTINE find_node (ptr, search, error)
00103     !
00104     !  Purpose:
00105     !    To find a particular node in the binary tree structure.
00106     !    "Search" is a pointer to the name to find, and will
00107     !    also contain the results when the subroutine finishes
00108     !    if the node is found.
00109     !
00110     TYPE (node), POINTER :: ptr    ! Pointer to curr pos. in tree
00111     TYPE (node), POINTER :: search ! Pointer to value to find.
00112     INTEGER :: error               ! Error: 0 = ok, 1 = not found
00113 
00114     IF ( search < ptr ) THEN
00115       IF ( ASSOCIATED(ptr%before) ) THEN
00116         CALL find_node (ptr%before, search, error)
00117       ELSE
00118         error = 1
00119       END IF
00120     ELSE IF ( search == ptr ) THEN
00121       search = ptr
00122       error = 0
00123     ELSE
00124       IF ( ASSOCIATED(ptr%after) ) THEN
00125         CALL find_node (ptr%after, search, error)
00126       ELSE
00127         error = 1
00128       END IF
00129     END IF
00130   END SUBROUTINE find_node

00132   RECURSIVE SUBROUTINE find_previous (ptr, search, prevNode, leftRight, error)
00133     !
00134     !  Purpose:
00135     !    To find the node just prior to the one of interest
00136     !
00137     TYPE (node), POINTER :: ptr    ! Pointer to curr pos. in tree
00138     TYPE (node), POINTER :: search ! Pointer to value to find.
00139     TYPE (node), POINTER :: prevNode ! Pointer to value to find.
00140     INTEGER :: error               ! Error: 0 = ok, 1 = not found
00141     INTEGER :: leftRight
00142     INTEGER :: assocstat
00143 
00144     ! PRINT *, "Now in find previous"
00145     ! PRINT *, "ptr at",ptr%coord1,ptr%coord2,ptr%coord3,ptr%wait_time
00146     ! PRINT *, "search at",search%coord1,search%coord2,search%coord3,search%wait_time
00147     leftRight = 99
00148     assocstat = 0
00149 
00150     ! Find association status of the pointers
00151     IF ( ASSOCIATED(ptr%before) .AND. ASSOCIATED(ptr%after) ) THEN
00152       assocstat = 1
00153     ELSE IF ( ASSOCIATED(ptr%before) ) THEN !.AND. (.NOT. ASSOCIATED(ptr%after)))) THEN
00154       assocstat = 2
00155     ELSE IF ( ASSOCIATED(ptr%after) ) THEN !.AND. (.NOT. ASSOCIATED(ptr%before))) THEN
00156       assocstat = 3
00157     END IF
00158 
00159     SELECT CASE (assocstat)
00160     CASE(0)
00161       PRINT *, "Both pointers null! Exiting!!"
00162       PRINT *, "search=",search%wait_time,search%coord1,search%coord2,search%coord3
00163       PRINT *, "ptr=",ptr%wait_time,ptr%coord1,ptr%coord2,ptr%coord3
00164       PRINT *, "Now writing ptr"
00165       CALL write_node(ptr)
00166       PRINT *, "Now writing search:"
00167       CALL write_node(search)
00168       error = 1
00169       CALL EXIT()
00170     CASE(1)
00171       IF ( search == ptr%before ) THEN
00172         prevNode => ptr
00173         error = 0
00174         leftRight = 0
00175       ELSE IF ( search == ptr%after ) THEN
00176   !      PRINT *, search%wait_time,"=after",ptr%wait_time
00177         prevNode => ptr
00178         error = 0
00179         leftRight = 1
00180       ELSE IF ( search < ptr ) THEN
00181   !      PRINT *, search%wait_time," is less than ptr%before"
00182           CALL find_previous (ptr%before, search, prevNode, leftRight, error)
00183       ELSE
00184         CALL find_previous (ptr%after, search, prevNode, leftRight, error)
00185       END IF
00186     CASE(2)
00187       IF ( search == ptr%before ) THEN
00188         prevNode => ptr
00189         error = 0
00190         leftRight = 0
00191       ELSE
00192         CALL find_previous (ptr%before, search, prevNode, leftRight, error)
00193       END IF
00194     CASE(3)
00195       IF ( search == ptr%after ) THEN
00196   !      PRINT *, search%wait_time,"=after",ptr%wait_time
00197         prevNode => ptr
00198         error = 0
00199         leftRight = 1
00200       ELSE
00201         CALL find_previous (ptr%after, search, prevNode, leftRight, error)
00202       END IF
00203     END SELECT
00204 !    PRINT *, "End find_previous"
00205   END SUBROUTINE find_previous

00219   RECURSIVE SUBROUTINE delete_node (root, toDelete, prevNode, nextNode, error)
00220     !
00221     !  Purpose:
00222     !    To find a particular node in the binary tree structure.
00223     !    "Search" is a pointer to the name to find, and will
00224     !    also contain the results when the subroutine finishes
00225     !    if the node is found.
00226     !
00227     TYPE (node), POINTER :: toDelete ! Node to delete
00228     TYPE (node), POINTER :: root     ! Root node
00229     TYPE (node), POINTER :: prevNode, nextNode
00230     INTEGER :: error                 ! Error: 0 = ok, 1 = not found
00231     INTEGER :: dType                 ! Deletion type: 0 = leaf node, 1 = one child, 2 = two children
00232     INTEGER :: d1,d2,d3              ! Coordinates 1, 2, and 3
00233     INTEGER :: onetype
00234     INTEGER :: twotype
00235 
00236     d1 = toDelete%coord1
00237     d2 = toDelete%coord2
00238     d3 = toDelete%coord3
00239 
00240     CALL node_type(toDelete,dType,onetype,twotype,0)
00241     IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
00242        IF ( dType .EQ. 1 ) PRINT *, "dType=",dType,"onetype=",onetype
00243        IF (dType .EQ. 2 ) PRINT *, "dType=",dType,"twotype=",twotype
00244     END IF
00245 
00246     SELECT CASE (dType)
00247     CASE (0)
00248        ! Since toDelete corresponds to a persistant lattice site, we just nullify
00249        ! the pointers and will re-add it to the tree later
00250        IF ( toDelete == root ) THEN
00251           NULLIFY(root)
00252           RETURN
00253        ELSE
00254           prevNode => toDelete%parent
00255           IF ( toDelete%leftRight .EQ. 0 ) THEN
00256              NULLIFY(prevNode%before,toDelete%parent)
00257           ELSE IF ( toDelete%leftRight .EQ. 1 ) THEN
00258              NULLIFY(prevNode%after,toDelete%parent)
00259           ELSE
00260              IF ( toDelete == root ) THEN
00261                 CONTINUE
00262              ELSE
00263                 IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, "leftRight=",toDelete%leftRight
00264                 !            CALL write_matrix_dataframe(root%coord1,root%coord2,root%coord3)
00265                 !            CALL write_matrix_dataframe(toDelete%coord1,toDelete%coord2,toDelete%coord3)
00266                 CALL EXIT()
00267              END IF
00268           END IF
00269        END IF
00270        toDelete%leftRight = -1
00271     CASE (1)
00272        IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, "onetype=",onetype
00273        SELECT CASE (onetype)
00274        CASE (0)
00275           PRINT *, "Error in onetype case: onetype=0"
00276           CALL EXIT()
00277        CASE (1)
00278           nextNode => toDelete%before
00279           prevNode => toDelete%parent
00280           nextNode%parent => prevNode        ! 1
00281           nextNode%leftRight = 0             ! 2
00282           prevNode%before => nextNode        ! 3
00283        CASE (2)
00284           nextNode => toDelete%before
00285           prevNode => toDelete%parent
00286           nextNode%parent => prevNode        ! 1
00287           prevNode%after =>  nextNode        ! 2
00288           nextNode%leftRight = 1             ! 3
00289        CASE (3)
00290           nextNode => toDelete%after
00291           prevNode => toDelete%parent
00292           nextNode%parent => prevNode        ! 1
00293           prevNode%before => nextNode        ! 2
00294           nextNode%leftRight = 0             ! 3
00295        CASE (4)
00296           nextNode => toDelete%after
00297           prevNode => toDelete%parent
00298           nextNode%parent => prevNode        ! 1
00299           prevNode%after => nextNode         ! 2
00300           nextNode%leftRight = 1             ! 3
00301        CASE (5)
00302           nextNode => toDelete%before
00303           NULLIFY(nextNode%parent)           ! 1
00304           nextNode%leftRight = -1            ! 2
00305           root => nextNode                   ! 3
00306        CASE (6)
00307           nextNode => toDelete%after
00308           NULLIFY(nextNode%parent)           ! 1
00309           nextNode%leftRight = -1            ! 2
00310           root => nextNode                   ! 3
00311        END SELECT
00312        IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, "Nullifying pointers"
00313        NULLIFY(matrix(d1,d2,d3)%before,matrix(d1,d2,d3)%after,matrix(d1,d2,d3)%parent)
00314        matrix(d1,d2,d3)%leftRight = -1
00315        IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, "Pointers nullified"
00316     CASE (2)
00317        ! First step is to delete the min of toDelete%after
00318        CALL find_min(toDelete%after,nextNode)
00319        toDelete => nextNode
00320        CALL delete_node(root,toDelete,prevNode,nextNode,error)
00321        IF ( DEBUG .EQV. .TRUE. ) PRINT *, "twotype=",twotype
00322        SELECT CASE (twotype)
00323        CASE (1)
00324           prevNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%before
00325           prevNode%parent => toDelete ! 1
00326           toDelete%before => prevNode ! 2
00327           root => toDelete
00328        CASE (2)
00329           prevNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%before
00330           nextNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%after
00331           prevNode%parent => toDelete ! 1
00332           nextNode%parent => toDelete ! 2
00333           toDelete%before => prevNode ! 3
00334           toDelete%after  => nextNode ! 4
00335           root => toDelete
00336        CASE (3)
00337           prevNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%before
00338           prevNode%parent => toDelete ! 1
00339           toDelete%before => prevNode ! 2
00340           root => toDelete
00341        CASE (4)
00342           prevNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%before
00343           nextNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%after
00344           prevNode%parent => toDelete ! 1
00345           nextNode%parent => toDelete ! 2
00346           toDelete%before => prevNode ! 3
00347           toDelete%after  => nextNode ! 4
00348           root => toDelete
00349        CASE (5)
00350           prevNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%before
00351           prevNode%parent => toDelete                     ! 1
00352           toDelete%before => prevNode                     ! 2
00353           toDelete%parent => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%parent      ! 3
00354           toDelete%leftRight = matrix(d1,d2,d3)%leftRight ! 4
00355           prevNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%parent
00356           IF ( toDelete%leftRight .EQ. 0 ) THEN           ! 5
00357              prevNode%before => toDelete
00358           ELSE
00359              prevNode%after  => toDelete
00360           END IF
00361        CASE (6)
00362           prevNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%before
00363           nextNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%after
00364           prevNode%parent => toDelete                     ! 1
00365           nextNode%parent => toDelete                     ! 2
00366           toDelete%before => prevNode                     ! 3
00367           toDelete%after  => nextNode                     ! 4
00368           toDelete%parent => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%parent      ! 5
00369           toDelete%leftRight = matrix(d1,d2,d3)%leftRight ! 6
00370           prevNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%parent
00371           IF ( toDelete%leftRight .EQ. 0 ) THEN           ! 7
00372              prevNode%before => toDelete
00373           ELSE
00374              prevNode%after => toDelete
00375           END IF
00376        CASE (7)
00377           prevNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%before
00378           prevNode%parent => toDelete                     ! 1
00379           toDelete%before => prevNode                     ! 2
00380           toDelete%parent => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%parent      ! 3
00381           toDelete%leftRight = matrix(d1,d2,d3)%leftRight ! 4
00382           prevNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%parent
00383           IF ( toDelete%leftRight .EQ. 0 ) THEN           ! 5
00384              prevNode%before => toDelete
00385           ELSE
00386              prevNode%after  => toDelete
00387           END IF
00388        CASE (8)
00389           prevNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%before
00390           nextNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%after
00391           prevNode%parent => toDelete                     ! 1
00392           nextNode%parent => toDelete                     ! 2
00393           toDelete%before => prevNode                     ! 3
00394           toDelete%after  => nextNode                     ! 4
00395           toDelete%parent => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%parent      ! 5
00396           toDelete%leftRight = matrix(d1,d2,d3)%leftRight ! 6
00397           prevNode => matrix(d1,d2,d3)%parent
00398           IF ( toDelete%leftRight .EQ. 0 ) THEN           ! 7
00399              prevNode%before => toDelete
00400           ELSE
00401              prevNode%after => toDelete
00402           END IF
00403        END SELECT
00404        NULLIFY(matrix(d1,d2,d3)%before,matrix(d1,d2,d3)%after,matrix(d1,d2,d3)%parent)
00405        matrix(d1,d2,d3)%leftRight = -1
00406     END SELECT
00407   END SUBROUTINE delete_node

00409   LOGICAL FUNCTION greater_than (op1, op2)
00410     !
00411     !  Purpose:
00412     !    To test to see if operand 1 is > operand 2
00413     !    in alphabetical order.
00414     !
00415     TYPE (node), INTENT(IN) :: op1, op2
00416 
00417     IF (op1%wait_time > op2%wait_time) THEN
00418       greater_than = .TRUE.
00419     ELSE IF ( op1%wait_time == op2%wait_time ) THEN
00420       IF ( op1%coord1 > op2%coord1 ) THEN
00421         greater_than = .TRUE.
00422       ELSE IF ( op1%coord1 == op2%coord1 ) THEN
00423         IF ( op1%coord2 > op2%coord2 ) THEN
00424           greater_than = .TRUE.
00425         ELSE IF ( op1%coord2 == op2%coord2 ) THEN
00426           IF ( op1%coord3 > op2%coord3 ) THEN
00427             greater_than = .TRUE.
00428           ELSE
00429             greater_than = .FALSE.
00430           END IF
00431         ELSE
00432           greater_than = .FALSE.
00433         END IF
00434       ELSE
00435         greater_than = .FALSE.
00436       END IF
00437     ELSE
00438       greater_than = .FALSE.
00439     END IF
00440   END FUNCTION greater_than
00441 
00442   LOGICAL FUNCTION less_than (op1, op2)
00443     !
00444     !  Purpose:
00445     !    To test to see if operand 1 is < operand 2
00446     !    in alphabetical order.
00447     !
00448     TYPE (node), INTENT(IN) :: op1, op2
00449 
00450 
00451     IF (op1%wait_time < op2%wait_time) THEN
00452       less_than = .TRUE.
00453     ELSE IF ( op1%wait_time == op2%wait_time ) THEN
00454       IF ( op1%coord1 < op2%coord1 ) THEN
00455         less_than = .TRUE.
00456       ELSE IF ( op1%coord1 == op2%coord1 ) THEN
00457         IF ( op1%coord2 < op2%coord2 ) THEN
00458           less_than = .TRUE.
00459         ELSE IF ( op1%coord2 == op2%coord2 ) THEN
00460           IF ( op1%coord3 < op2%coord3 ) THEN
00461             less_than = .TRUE.
00462           ELSE
00463             less_than = .FALSE.
00464           END IF
00465         ELSE
00466           less_than = .FALSE.
00467         END IF
00468       ELSE
00469         less_than = .FALSE.
00470       END IF
00471     ELSE
00472       less_than = .FALSE.
00473     END IF
00474   END FUNCTION less_than

00476   LOGICAL FUNCTION equal_to (op1, op2)
00477     !
00478     !  Purpose:
00479     !    To test to see if operand 1 is equal to operand 2
00480     !    alphabetically.
00481     !
00482     TYPE (node), INTENT(IN) :: op1, op2
00483 
00484     IF ( (op1%wait_time == op2%wait_time ) .AND. &
00485          (op1%coord1 == op2%coord1) .AND. &
00486          (op1%coord2 == op2%coord2) .AND. &
00487          (op1%coord3 == op2%coord3) ) THEN
00488       equal_to = .TRUE.
00489     ELSE
00490       equal_to = .FALSE.
00491     END IF
00492   END FUNCTION equal_to

00494   RECURSIVE SUBROUTINE node_type (temp, dType, onetype, twotype, recursive )
00495     !
00496     !  Purpose:
00497     !    To find a particular node in the binary tree structure.
00498     !    "Search" is a pointer to the name to find, and will
00499     !    also contain the results when the subroutine finishes
00500     !    if the node is found.
00501     !
00502     IMPLICIT NONE
00503     TYPE (node), POINTER :: temp ! Node to delete
00504     INTEGER :: dType, dType1, dType2                 ! Deletion type: 0 = leaf node, 1 = one child, 2 = two children
00505     INTEGER :: onetype, twotype
00506     LOGICAL :: leftBranch
00507     LOGICAL :: rightBranch
00508 !    LOGICAL :: recursive
00509     INTEGER :: recursive
00510 
00511     dType       = 0
00512     dType1      = 0
00513     dType2      = 0
00514     onetype     = 0
00515     twotype     = 0
00516     leftBranch  = .FALSE.
00517     rightBranch = .FALSE.
00518 
00519     IF ( ASSOCIATED(temp%before) ) THEN
00520       ! PRINT *, "Before node="
00521       CALL write_node(temp%before)
00522       dType = dType + 1
00523       leftBranch = .TRUE.
00524     END IF
00525 
00526     IF ( ASSOCIATED(temp%after)) THEN
00527       ! PRINT *, "After node="
00528       CALL write_node(temp%after)
00529       dType = dType + 1
00530       rightBranch = .TRUE.
00531     END IF
00532 
00533     ! Determine Type 1 case
00534     IF ( dType .EQ. 1 ) THEN
00535       IF ( (temp%leftRight .EQ. 0) .AND. (leftBranch .EQV. .TRUE. ) ) THEN
00536         onetype = 1
00537       ELSE IF ( (temp%leftRight .EQ. 1) .AND. (leftBranch .EQV. .TRUE.) ) THEN
00538         onetype = 2
00539       ELSE IF ( (temp%leftRight .EQ. 0) .AND. (rightBranch .EQV. .TRUE. ) ) THEN
00540         onetype = 3
00541       ELSE IF ( (temp%leftRight .EQ. 1) .AND. (rightBranch .EQV. .TRUE.) ) THEN
00542         onetype = 4
00543       ELSE IF ( (temp%leftRight .EQ. -1) .AND. (leftBranch .EQV. .TRUE.) ) THEN
00544         onetype = 5
00545       ELSE IF ( (temp%leftRight .EQ. -1) .AND. (rightBranch .EQV. .TRUE.) ) THEN
00546         onetype = 6
00547       END IF
00548     END IF
00549 
00550     IF ( dType .EQ. 2 ) THEN
00551 !      IF ( recursive .EQV. .TRUE. ) THEN
00552        IF ( recursive == 0 ) THEN
00553 !        recursive = .FALSE.
00554         CALL node_type(temp%before,dType1,onetype,twotype,1)
00555         CALL node_type(temp%after,dType2,onetype,twotype,1)
00556         IF ( .NOT. ASSOCIATED(temp%parent) ) THEN
00557           ! Root node
00558           IF ( (dType1 .EQ. 0) .AND. (dType2 .EQ. 0 ) ) THEN
00559             twotype = 1
00560           ELSE IF ( (dType1 .EQ. 0) .AND. (dType2 .NE. 0 ) ) THEN
00561             twotype = 2
00562           ELSE IF ( (dType1 .NE. 0) .AND. (dType2 .EQ. 0 ) ) THEN
00563             twotype = 3
00564           ELSE IF ( (dType1 .NE. 0) .AND. (dType2 .NE. 0 ) ) THEN
00565             twotype = 4
00566           END IF
00567         ELSE
00568           ! Not root node
00569           IF ( (dType1 .EQ. 0) .AND. (dType2 .EQ. 0 ) ) THEN
00570             twotype = 5
00571           ELSE IF ( (dType1 .EQ. 0) .AND. (dType2 .NE. 0 ) ) THEN
00572             twotype = 6
00573           ELSE IF ( (dType1 .NE. 0) .AND. (dType2 .EQ. 0 ) ) THEN
00574             twotype = 7
00575           ELSE IF ( (dType1 .NE. 0) .AND. (dType2 .NE. 0 ) ) THEN
00576             twotype = 8
